subject: MAP: Provisioning cadence and close timeline for ClearWave evaluation
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Qureshi <amir@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Provisioning cadence and close timeline for ClearWave evaluation

Amir,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the product team is excited about the evaluation opportunity. Attached is a focused mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the provisioning steps we need to hit a production-like evaluation by Oct 28. High-level asks are below; the attached PDF has the full milestone table.

Key provisioning actions (owner / target):
- Org & IAM: Redwood to provision evaluation org and invite ClearWave admins (Redwood: 10/02)
- API keys: generate scoped eval API keys; rotate policy for safe sandboxing (Redwood: 10/03)
- IP allowlist: ClearWave to provide public egress ranges (ClearWave: 10/05)
- VPC peering: schedule peering request; exchange subnets and BGP CIDR notes (mutual: target 10/12)
- Test corpus & traffic profile: ClearWave to upload a redacted sample data set and request profile (ClearWave: 10/08)

Notes and dependencies:
- We will use a non-prod tenant; no PHI should be in the initial corpus. If you need an on-prem option later we can swap to Private deployment.
- For VPC peering we support AWS <-> AWS peering (account IDs needed) and cross-account route tables; if you prefer site-to-site VPN, call that out and we’ll adjust the timeline.

Attachments: RW-CLW-MAP-20261001.pdf (MAP with milestone owner matrix), clearwave-allowlist-template.csv (CSV template for IP ranges).

Next steps: please confirm owners and the IP ranges + preferred peering window by EOD 10/05. Once we have the ranges we will provision the API keys and open test endpoints.

Best,
Hannah
Head of Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

--
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 415-555-0189

From: Amir Qureshi <amir@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah O'Neill <sarah.oneill@clearwavehealth.com>, ClearWave IT <it@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 11:23:14 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP: Provisioning cadence and close timeline for ClearWave evaluation

Thanks, Hannah — this looks sensible. A couple of clarifications before we lock dates: 

1) IP ranges: we have two egress ranges (10.14.32.0/24 and 10.14.33.0/24) that will be NATed through our perimeter. Do you need our NAT IPs or the internal CIDRs?
2) VPC peering: we prefer to start with peering (AWS) but might defer to a VPN if our security team flags cross-account peering in the SOC review. What is the earliest you can kick off the peering from your side once we share account IDs?
3) API keys: can they be scoped to the evaluation tenant and limited to the test model set (so we don't accidentally run against prod models)?

Sarah (cc) is our security lead — she’ll route the SOC-related checklist if needed. We aim to have the IP list and account IDs to you by COB 10/04.

–Amir
VP of Product
ClearWave Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Qureshi <amir@clearwavehealth.com>, Sarah O'Neill <sarah.oneill@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Provisioning cadence and close timeline for ClearWave evaluation

Hi Amir / Sarah — adding a few operational and security details so we can avoid back-and-forth later.

- API keys: we will generate tenant-scoped keys that are limited to the evaluation model family (gpt-ev-1 / embeddings-ev-1). Keys will be labeled "clearwave-eval-YYYYMMDD" and created in read+generate mode; no admin privileges. Keys will also have TTL of 90 days by default; we can shorten on request.
- IP allowlist: please provide the public NAT IPs that ClearWave publishes; we need the AAA.BBB.CCC.DDD/32 addresses (not the internal 10.x ranges). I attached the small CSV template (clearwave-allowlist-template.csv) — fill the "source_ip" column.
- VPC peering: if you opt for AWS peering, we'll need: Redwood account (to be provided 10/05), your account ID, and the VPC CIDR you'd like to peer (must not overlap). Peering requests typically finish in 24–48 hours once both account IDs and a contact are provided. For cross-account security reasons we can place the eval cluster in an isolated subnet; Marcus will outline network guardrails below.

Marcus: see action for 10/06 to prepare ephemeral subnets and route table templates.

Amir — if you can confirm you’ll send public NAT IPs and account IDs by COB 10/04, we’ll create the API key and open the test endpoint by 10/06.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: clearwave-allowlist-template.csv

From: Amir Qureshi <amir@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Sarah O'Neill <sarah.oneill@clearwavehealth.com>, ClearWave IT <it@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 16:32:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP: Provisioning cadence and close timeline for ClearWave evaluation

Kimberly — perfect, that answers our questions. We confirmed the public NAT IPs (attached below) and will send the AWS account ID + VPC CIDR first thing Tue 10/05.

Public NAT IPs (for your firewall):
- 34.120.45.76/32
- 34.120.45.77/32

We have filled your CSV and uploaded it to the Drive link you provided. Sarah says the SOC review should be light because the test tenant only exposes non-PHI test data. She’ll follow up if anything changes.

Confirming the timeline:
- 10/05: ClearWave provides account ID + VPC CIDR (we will).
- 10/06: Redwood issues tenant-scoped API key and opens test endpoint.
- 10/12: VPC peering to be completed (target).
- 10/28: Production-like evaluation complete; go/no-go decision meeting.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting started.

–Amir
VP of Product | ClearWave Health
